description: Find developers (primary market) by a fragment of the name, e.g. atal or dom development. Use it to turn a developer's name into the developer_slug that deweloperuch_search_investments takes (with city) to list that developer's investments. Returns no offers or prices. truncated=true means more developers match than shown: refine the name or raise limit (at most 20); total is null when it is only known that there are more. deweloperuch.pl is a free community project queried politely (one request at a time, results cached): if a result is an error starting with STOP, stop using the deweloperuch_* tools, retry nothing, look for no workaround and tell the user that market data is temporarily unavailable. Fields ending in _url are pages of deweloperuch.pl: give them to the user as links. Result shape: { total: number | null, returned, truncated, hint?, items: [{ developer_slug, name, offer_count? (the site's count of the developer's offers across Poland), developer_url? }] } — the list key is `items`. developer_url is the developer's profile for the whole of Poland on deweloperuch.pl.

limit.description: Most developers in the result, 1–20, default 5 (about 150 characters each).

name.description: Fragment of a developer name, 2–100 characters, e.g. atal, Dom Development.

name: deweloperuch_search_developers
title: Search developers
